title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.
